snippet.title: Northanda Chronicles – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
TRY THE DEMO TODAY ON STEAM!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068650/Northanda_Chronicles

Master role-driven combat in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit three heroes from countless combinations, craft a shared deck of powerful abilities, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

Follow us for more:
Discord: discord.gg/dx9nVvAn4g
Twitter: https://x.com/HyperfocusI

Thanks for watching!

#NorthandaChronicles #IndieGame #StrategyGame #Roguelike #Deckbuilder #GameplayTrailer
